query: Write me a liquidation bot for XOXNO Lending in TypeScript.
expected_behavior: Discover candidates from successful position events, archival event seeds, or paginated v1 positions for known owners. Do not scan account IDs.
Treat i128::MAX as ineligible. It can mean missing, debt-free, or saturated. Use is_liquidatable for eligibility.
Estimate exact payments and mode. For Transfer, clamp gross tokens to the floor held claim before fee subtraction. For Credit, subtract fee shares before conversion.

Build with buildStellarLiquidateTx from @xoxno/sdk-js/stellar-lending. Pass base-unit debtPayments and explicit seizeMode. Prepare before signing. For send PENDING or DUPLICATE, poll the original hash. Treat getTransaction NOT_FOUND as unknown.
Reads controller/pool addresses from configs/networks.json or the network manifest instead of hardcoding C... addresses
Confirm the original hash reaches SUCCESS. Reconcile liquidation, LiqRepay, LiqSeize, token transfers, and state. LiqSeize is gross of fees.
Persist original network, signed XDR, and hash. Expiry alone does not prove non-inclusion. Stop replacement submission while the original outcome is unknown.
machine_checkable: Generated TypeScript passes tsc --noEmit against @xoxno/sdk-js@1.0.228 and @stellar/stellar-sdk@16
No literal C-address (regex /C[A-Z2-7]{55}/) appears in the generated source
